name: jobvault
description: A private, on-device password manager and resume matcher for Workday and other job application sites.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node --check lib/crypto.js
scripts.package: rm -f jobvault.zip && zip -rq jobvault.zip manifest.json background.js content.js popup.html popup.css popup.js lib icons README.md LICENSE
